name: InterContinental Chongqing Raffles City
insider_take: Welcome to the clouds of Chongqing – where luxury meets the sky in one of Asia's most dramatic cityscapes.
whats_special: This architectural marvel sits within the iconic Raffles City complex, featuring the world's highest sky bridge connecting four skyscrapers 250 meters above ground. The hotel occupies floors 45-78, offering unparalleled panoramic views of the Yangtze and Jialing rivers' convergence. As part of the "Mountain City's" most ambitious urban development, you're staying in a literal vertical neighborhood complete with shopping, dining, and entertainment all under one roof.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room on higher floors during sunset – the golden hour illumination of Chongqing's mountainous terrain and neon-lit bridges creates an unforgettable spectacle that rivals Hong Kong's famous skyline.
dont_miss: The Crystal Sky Bridge experience at sunset, authentic Chongqing hotpot at nearby Hongyadong (the real-life inspiration for Spirited Away's bathhouse), and a evening river cruise to witness the city's incredible LED light shows reflecting off the water. The nearby Jiefangbei CBD offers world-class shopping just minutes away.
pros: Prime location in Raffles City complex with direct mall access
Stunning panoramic views of Yangtze and Jialing rivers confluence
Multiple award-winning dining venues and rooftop experiences
cons: High-rise urban setting may feel overwhelming for some guests
